purpose.zh: 练手臂后侧，推到顶把手肘完全伸直
purpose.en: Build the back of your arms and straighten your elbows fully at the top.

text.zh: 手肘贴着身体往后弯，推起后伸直停一下
text.en: Bend with your elbows close to your body, then press up and pause straight
Place your hands shoulder-width apart or a little narrower.

text.zh: 身体一条直线，把地面推远。
text.en: Keep your body in one line and push the floor away.

commonErrors.en: Starting the next rep before your arms are straight.

cautions.zh: 手腕不舒服时先活动一下手腕
cautions.en: If your wrists feel stiff, warm them up first.

cautions.zh: 手腕刺痛或发麻时马上停
cautions.en: Stop right away if your wrists feel sharp pain or numbness.

changes: 节奏按 spec：下 1.3 s / 底 0.2 s / 推起 1.0 s / 顶端伸直停 1.5 s（rest 段）
口令重排：原 peak「推起锁肘」end「停一秒」错位 → 慢慢下去 → 推起伸直
flags: 顶端伸直停约 1.5 s（这个动作的重点）落在 rest 段、不念口令；批表 down 轨 hold 0.63 是底部+顶端混算
